# CCI Stepping Out of Social Anxiety Modules

The Centre for Clinical Interventions provides a modular social-anxiety workbook series. The modules cover understanding social anxiety, attention and thinking patterns, safety behaviours, and practice exercises that can be worked through step by step.

For this project, CCI is used as a structural reference for modular self-help design. SocialEase Agent should create its own concise worksheets and should not reproduce long external workbook content verbatim.
